message.mikucompanion.intro: Miku Companion loaded. %1$s: call Miku, %2$s: wait/follow, %3$s: send away. Keys can be changed under Options > Controls.
message.mikucompanion.summon.2: [Miku] Oh... did you call me? I'm here.
message.mikucompanion.wait: [Miku] I'll wait here. Take your time.
message.mikucompanion.not_here: Miku isn't here right now. Call her with %1$s.
message.mikucompanion.no_safe_spot: [Miku] ...It feels too dangerous here. Maybe somewhere else?
